description: Build an unsigned config-change proposal. op=add-member needs member (+optional permissions); remove-member needs member; change-threshold needs threshold. Only works on m-of-n multisigs (no single config authority).

member.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

multisig.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

permissions.description: What this member is allowed to do. All three are independent.

execute.description: May execute a proposal once it reaches threshold.

proposer.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

name: solknife_multisig_config_build
